values.task_boundary: Prepare and coordinate only Sprint 8 umbrella #536 and its exact current eight-member active roster; retain #84 as independent backlog without starting or absorbing its work.
deliverables: Sprint Execution Packet with exact membership, safe lanes, serial gates, review path, and activity log
Integrated sprint review and truthful umbrella closeout record
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The Sprint Execution Packet records exact active membership #51, #261, #262, #263, #264, #342, #511, and #512 plus the independent backlog disposition for #84 and dependency order.
AC-2: Podcast and Observatory parallel lanes, their serial gates, collision boundaries, and operator-controlled actions are explicit.
AC-3: Every child has a complete typed six-card bundle and issue-specific design-time plan before implementation handoff.
AC-4: Every child handoff requires a bound FastWork worktree, current readiness, and issue-bound session goal before implementation.
AC-5: #512 depends on reviewed terminal #511 only and is not gated by backlog #84; #264 remains blocked until explicit provider-specific operator authorization.
AC-6: The umbrella closes only after current members have reviewed terminal outcomes or explicit operator-approved dispositions and one integrated sprint review has no unresolved actionable findings.
repo_inputs: GitHub issues #51, #261, #262, #263, #264, #342, #511, and #512 plus independent backlog issue #84
non_goals: Implementing child code, documents, media, hosting, or provider actions
Claiming parallel execution beyond the packet
Moving work owned by another sprint into Sprint 8
